name: Bereguardo (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bereguardo (a red tower on white above a green base, crowned, within branches).
history: Municipal flag of Bereguardo, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bereguardo arms — a red tower on white above a green base, crowned, within branches
